paragraphs: R. Neḥunya ben Elanḥan, of Kefar HaBavli, Eduyot 6, mishnah 2, נ׳ [additional source locator unresolved], disagrees with R. Eliezer and R. Yehoshua; another version, Neḥemyah. Bekhorot 12 and Ḥullin 129b attribute this to R. Neḥunya ben HaKanah; this appears a scribal error. It is the matter in Eduyot 6:3, which mentions simply R. Neḥunya, R. Eliezer and R. Yehoshua. Surely it is R. Neḥunya ben Elanḥan, mentioned immediately before in mishnah 2. A baraita has R. Neḥunya in R. Neḥunya the Great's name.
